description: This file contains the implementation of the Sys Rro Hcxt Object, including creation, destruction, object enrollment, and initialization functions for managing the system resource context object in a network system component.

classes.name: SYS_RRO_HCXT_OBJECT
classes.description: The main object structure representing the system resource context in the Rro component, including member functions and properties such as OID, record data, and object methods.

methods.name: ANSC_HANDLE SysRroHcxtCreate(ANSC_HANDLE hContainerContext,ANSC_HANDLE hOwnerContext,ANSC_HANDLE hAnscReserved)
methods.description: Constructs the Sys Rro Hcxt Object, allocates memory, and sets up initial function pointers and member variables.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS SysRroHcxtRemove(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Destroys the object and performs cleanup.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS SysRroHcxtEnrollObjects(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Enrolls necessary subordinate objects required by the main object.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS SysRroHcxtInitialize(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Initializes object member variables and function pointers, calling base class initialization where necessary.
